content: {"like":["Enjoys uplifting, underdog sports stories, especially baseball films featuring strong performances and charismatic characters like James Gammon and Bob Uecker; appreciates classic, well‑executed movies that he owns on VHS and watches repeatedly."],"dislike":["Dislikes poorly written or over‑presented love interests, especially when female characters are underdeveloped or portrayed as incompetent; strongly objects to gratuitous violence, intrusive music, and any content that feels demeaning or shallow; is critical of films that alter original music, age actors noticeably, or include unnecessary or offensive remarks."]}
